Context: (b) For Half Pay Leave

## (b) For Half Pay Leave  
Half Pay Leave salary + DA on that date  
30  
No. of days of Half Pay Leave at credit subject to the total of earned leave and HPL at credit not exceeding 300 days  
The overall limit for encashment of leave including both earned leave and Half Pay Leave shall not exceed 300 days. To make up for the shortfall in earned leave, no commutation of Half Pay Leave shall be admissible. - Rule 39, Leave Rules.
